data.body:
Completion evidence for 1a63 / CL 2660:

Validity by file on current origin/main before edits:
- docs/env-vars.md: no retired-spelling hits; generated env docs already omitted old aliases.
- docs/config-reference.md: only canonical verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets row; no verify.overlap_enabled.
- tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py: no retired-spelling hits.
- tests/golden/config_surface.json: canonical config/env entries only; old COMPACT_THRESHOLD/SCRATCH_BASE_DIR hits are substrings of REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD/REBAR_SCRATCH_BASE_DIR.
- docs/api-stability.md: already aligned before this change; lines 27 and 33-34 cite ADR 0116 and the pre-1.0 operator-approved clean-removal exception.
- docs/config.md, docs/bash-migration.md, docs/concurrency.md, docs/release-notes.md, CHANGELOG.md had remaining stale/live-alias publication gaps and were fixed in CL 2660.

Release/changelog mapping evidence:
- CHANGELOG.md lines 41-52 name every removed spelling and replacement: REBAR_NO_SYNC -> REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off, COMPACT_THRESHOLD -> REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD, SCRATCH_BASE_DIR -> REBAR_SCRATCH_BASE_DIR, REBAR_ACLI_TIMEOUT -> REBAR_JIRA_CLI_TIMEOUT, RECONCILER_ABSENT_GET_BUDGET -> REBAR_RECONCILER_DELETION_PROBE_LIMIT, REBAR_ID_GUARD_MODE=warn -> REBAR_UNSAFE_ID_GUARD_BYPASS=true, REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED -> REBAR_VERIFY_SUGGEST_DUPLICATE_TICKETS, verify.overlap_enabled -> verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets.
- docs/release-notes.md lines 11-29 publish the same ADR 0116 mapping table and call out the semantic migrations.

Live-doc canonical evidence:
- docs/config.md lines 156, 184, 213, 240, 348, 355, 360 now show only canonical env/config spellings in live examples.
- docs/config.md lines 850-853 replace permanent-alias prose with ADR 0116 canonical-only guidance.
- docs/bash-migration.md lines 25-28 now names only fetch and --no-pull opt-out.
- docs/concurrency.md lines 840-845 now names REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off and --no-pull, not REBAR_NO_SYNC as a live alias.

Census evidence:
A repo-wide census of the eight retired spellings was run after edits. Remaining matches are classified as: explicit migration docs in CHANGELOG.md/docs/release-notes.md; ADR/history in docs/adr/0116 and docs/adr/0086 / experiment fixtures; regression tests and tombstone/removal tests under tests/unit; generated config_surface canonical names where COMPACT_THRESHOLD/SCRATCH_BASE_DIR are substrings of REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD/REBAR_SCRATCH_BASE_DIR; and .rebar/usage.jsonl LLM telemetry. No live guidance in docs/config.md, docs/env-vars.md, docs/config-reference.md, docs/bash-migration.md, or docs/concurrency.md presents retired names as aliases.

Gate evidence:
- RED oracle: session artifact oracle_1a63_docs.py failed on current main because docs/config.md still contained live alias guidance.
- GREEN oracle: same oracle passed after edits.
- Mutation teeth: sandboxed mutation reintroduced REBAR_NO_SYNC live-alias text in docs/config.md; oracle failed, then passed after restoration.
- Targeted tests: pytest tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py => 34 passed.
- make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS.
- Full local make test: baseline hit the documented macOS repo-isolation artifact; rerun with requested deselects then hit unrelated host gate-congestion failures while other sessions held plan-review slots. Gerrit Verified subsequently passed the full CI gate.
- Gerrit CL 2660: Verified+1, LLM-Review+1, unresolved comments 0, submitted/merged.
